scope:
IN SCOPE (LEAD-CORRECTED 2026-09-06, evidence rows e6fe32c3/4745bcf2). FR-1 RECEIPT AT DRAIN, WIDENED: QF-20260906-162 (PR #8338, merged) already ships the write site for signal_type=stuck AND severity=high only (printInbox -> writeSignalReceipts -> dispatchToWorker, correlation_id-idempotent, exempt from send-time backpressure). This SD's FR-1 delta is: (a) widen the filter to every worker /signal row regardless of type/severity; (b) add a rendered disposition line (queued | routed:<target> | needs-decision:<who>) INTO body/subject text -- coordination-inbox.cjs's render is a fixed payload-field allowlist, so a payload-only field never displays (TST-B2); (c) add 'signal_receipt' to INFORMATIONAL_KINDS (worker-status.cjs) in addition to its existing BACKPRESSURE_EXEMPT_KINDS membership, closing STEP-0 rider (a) fully regardless of QF-20260904-695's landing order -- confirmed this needs NO migration (INFORMATIONAL_KINDS is not spread into role_drain_sets). ADAM-ADVISORY RECEIPTS ARE CUT FROM THIS SD (deletion audit Q8): widening into printAdamInbox as originally scoped is an unbounded duplicate-write bug (TST-B3 -- 200-row fetch behind a 50-row existence-check window, rows never auto-drained, permanent re-receipt every render) that needs its own design, not a bolt-on; filed as a follow-up QF instead of shipped here. coordinator_request rows stay in scope (same printInbox batch as worker signals).

FR-2 CAPPED-POOL BROADCAST, MECHANISM CORRECTED: target_session='broadcast' as originally specified is dead by construction -- BOTH sub-agents independently confirmed zero worker read path unions the bare sentinel (coordination-inbox.cjs, worker-status.cjs getMessagesForSession all match exact session id or a role-scoped sentinel; the only NULL-target reader is drain-reservations.cjs, scoped to reservation kinds only; orphan-reroute-sweep skips informational kinds so there is no rescue path either). CORRECTED MECHANISM, same outcome (worker inbox drain (surfaceCoordinatorMessages via /checkin) already surfaces any message_type=INFO row addressed to a live session regardless of kind, so this reaches workers without a DRAIN_SETS change): coordinator tick fans out ONE directed INFO row per live seat (lib/fleet/live-fleet-sessions.cjs liveFleetSessions()), all rows sharing one run_id/broadcast_id for grouping, kind=capped_pool_broadcast, backpressure-exempt (mirrors the signal_receipt precedent -- requires the same 4-way change: BACKPRESSURE_EXEMPT_KINDS in dispatch.cjs + worker-status.cjs, a new role_drain_sets migration, and the matching seed-count/RECONCILIATION_MIGRATION_PATHS test updates) and added to INFORMATIONAL_KINDS (no migration needed for that half). Fire-once/re-emit-window logic reuses the emitReaperStarvationAlert pattern (coordination-events.cjs:855) -- dedupe by an existing unacknowledged unexpired row of the same kind per target, expires_at giving the 6h re-emit window; over-cap-since tracking and the one-more-notice-on-clear transition use a small JSON state file mirroring scripts/fleet/worktree-reaper-tick.cjs's readState/writeState (co-located pattern, no new machinery). Trigger source: countActiveWorktrees()/MAX_WORKTREE_COUNT (lib/worktree-quota.js, ESM -- read via dynamic import from the CJS tick, per validation-agent note).

FR-3 CONSTRAINTS IN THE ASSIGNMENT BODY, ANCHOR CORRECTED: buildWorkAssignment does not exist anywhere in the repo (both sub-agents independently confirmed). The real choke point is insertCoordinationRow (lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs, ~line 1214), which already runs three fail-soft stamper guards keyed on message_type==='WORK_ASSIGNMENT' (stampEffortRecommendation, stampModelRecommendation, stampPremiseMeasurement) -- FR-3 adds a fourth, stampConstraintsBlock, following the identical pattern. MUST run BEFORE the body/payload.body mirror fill-if-absent (~line 1468) -- appending after the mirror makes the two copies diverge for payload-side readers (TST-B4). MUST apply the existing capBodySafe (lib/shared/body-cap.cjs) to the rendered block -- insertCoordinationRow applies no body cap today. Reads holds via resolveHoldProvenance + formatHoldProvenance (lib/fleet/claim-eligibility.cjs, already exported) per the SD's own STEP-0 rider (b) -- this is a descriptive/informational surface (every constraint a worker should see before editing), deliberately NOT isUnreleasedChairmanHold's narrower must-act-before-completion predicate (a different question); resolveHoldProvenance's known 6c263823-era over-match against completed SDs (TST-B5) is immaterial here since WORK_ASSIGNMENT is never dispatched to a terminal-status SD (assertSdDispatchable already refuses that upstream). PREREQUISITE: rider (b) sequences FR-3 after QF-20260904-724 (open, unclaimed, ~4-key widening of resolveHoldProvenance's key list) -- since it is small, well-specified, and unclaimed, this SD's EXEC lands QF-724's fix itself as a first commit rather than wait on another session, so 'none recorded' renders only when the resolver genuinely finds nothing, never a false-bare on a documented hold. Also surfaces ratifications_cited (already present on live SD rows, e.g. this SD's own metadata) and any Solomon ruling text recorded in metadata.

FR-4 PREVENTIVE EXIT PREDICATES IN CI (ratification 49656c8c), CORRECTED: (a) drain fixture asserts one receipt per drained worker-signal row (any type/severity) and zero effect on the backpressure count -- reuses the dispatch-send-backpressure.test.js stub pattern; (b) pool-over-cap fixture asserts one broadcast fan-out (N directed rows, one per live seat) then silence for the re-emit window, using the state-file pattern's own test precedent (worktree-reaper-tick tests); (c) assignment fixture with a review-held SD asserts the CONSTRAINTS block names the hold, using the fleet-dashboard-signal-receipt.test.js permissive-double pattern since dispatchToWorker/insertCoordinationRow cannot be vi.mock'd across a CJS-CJS require boundary; (d) count of worker signals older than 30 minutes with no receipt row, asserted at zero from the merge commit -- existence-check limit MUST cover the full enumerated batch size (not a fixed 20/50 regardless of batch), and a lookup-error catch must report unknown/error, never a false-pass zero (TST-B6).

OUT OF SCOPE (unchanged plus): the backpressure counter's own defect (Tier-1 QF 47cd9f79); the worktree pool cap and reclaim (QF-508, PRESERVE-001); the coordinator's drain cadence; any new comms lane; Adam-advisory receipt widening (filed as a follow-up QF per the Q8 deletion above); QF-20260906-162's own escalated duplicate SD-LEO-FIX-DELIVERY-RECEIPT-SEVERITY-001 (flagged to the coordinator via /signal need-sweep 4248827f for closure as already-delivered -- not touched by this SD).

STEP-0 RIDERS ADOPTED (Solomon a6af3aab) -- SUPERSEDED IN PART: rider's PREFERRED SHAPE (an UPDATE on the signal row with a receipted_at field) is superseded by the ROW shape QF-20260906-162 already shipped to production (matches this SD's own original IN SCOPE text); re-litigating the shape now would mean reverting merged code. FR-4(d)'s zero-asserted gauge reads correlation_id-linked signal_receipt ROWS (lib/fleet/outstanding-signals.cjs's existing 'received' predicate), not a receipted_at field. Rider (a) and (b) otherwise stand as corrected above.

lead_evaluation.q1_need_validation: Real: 3 independent measured incidents this week (signal-receipt latency, 5x seat-by-seat broadcast explanation, a masked governance rule) all trace to one cause -- coordinator state invisible where the waiting seat sits.
lead_evaluation.q2_solution_alignment: Yes, aligned with the fleet-hardening campaign (harness root-cause week b046d398).
lead_evaluation.q3_existing_tools: Heavily reused after LEAD correction: emitReaperStarvationAlert's fire-once pattern, insertCoordinationRow's existing stamper-guard pattern, resolveHoldProvenance/formatHoldProvenance, liveFleetSessions(), worktree-reaper-tick.cjs's state-file pattern. Original spec named two non-existent/non-functional anchors (buildWorkAssignment, target_session='broadcast') -- both corrected to real, working infrastructure before PLAN.
lead_evaluation.q4_value_analysis: Yes -- each FR closes a concretely measured recurrence (50-170min unreceipted signals; 5 duplicate explanations in one day; a load-bearing rule discovered after the fact).
lead_evaluation.q5_feasibility: Feasible after correction. FR-3 has one external prerequisite (QF-20260904-724) folded into this SD's own EXEC since it was small and unclaimed.
lead_evaluation.q6_risk_assessment: Primary risks were the two dead-by-construction anchors (FR-2 broadcast target, FR-3 buildWorkAssignment) -- both found and corrected at LEAD via validation-agent + testing-agent, not discovered mid-EXEC. Residual risk: FR-2's fan-out backpressure-exemption requires a 4th role_drain_sets migration (mechanical, twice-precedented).
lead_evaluation.q7_simplicity: Adam-advisory receipt widening cut (Q8) as unnecessary complexity for this SD's core outcome; FR-2 redesigned to reuse an existing pattern rather than invent new broadcast machinery.
lead_evaluation.q8_deletion_audit: Cut: (1) Adam-advisory receipt widening from FR-1 (duplicate-write risk, needs its own design -- filed as follow-up QF); (2) the rider's UPDATE-shape preference for receipts (superseded by shipped ROW shape); (3) buildWorkAssignment as a target (function does not exist -- redirected to the real choke point, not a scope cut but an anchor correction). Estimated scope reduction vs original SD text: ~15% (one full FR sub-clause cut, two mechanism corrections that removed dead-code paths rather than adding them).
